changeSet.author: bianca.carapcea@db.com
changeSet.createView: SELECT rb.id AS break_id, rb.discrepancy_type, rb.created_at AS detected_at, t.trade_ref, t.quantity, t.price, i.symbol AS instrument, cp.name AS counterparty, cp.region FROM recon_breaks rb JOIN trades t ON t.id = rb.trade_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.id = t.counterparty_id WHERE rb.status = 'OPEN'

changeSet.author: bianca.carapcea@db.com
changeSet.createView: SELECT t.trade_ref, t.trade_date, s.settled_at, (CAST(s.settled_at AS DATE) - t.trade_date) AS lag_days, s.status AS settlement_status FROM settlements s JOIN trades t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.status = 'SETTLED'
